query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aiRecommendations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  storeId INT NOT NULL,
  zoneId INT,
  planogramId INT,
  productId INT,
  type ENUM('reposition', 'facing', 'cross_merchandising', 'dereference', 'new_product') NOT NULL,
  priority ENUM('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical') DEFAULT 'medium' NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  currentValue TEXT,
  suggestedValue TEXT,
  estimatedImpact INT,
  estimatedImpactPercent INT,
  confidence INT NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending', 'applied', 'dismissed', 'expired') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  appliedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  appliedBy INT,
  dismissedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  dismissedBy INT,
  expiresAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS performanceScores (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  storeId INT NOT NULL,
  planogramId INT,
  productId INT,
  period VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  salesScore INT NOT NULL,
  rotationScore INT NOT NULL,
  marginScore INT NOT NULL,
  complianceScore INT NOT NULL,
  overallScore INT NOT NULL,
  salesAmount INT,
  stockLevel INT,
  rotationDays INT,
  marginPercent INT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
